opening.argument: The presentation ties paid OneCoin packages to mining rights and increased profit: “the more tokens have more money and profit and the more coins have to earn.” It gives a 5,000-euro package example associated with about 50,000 coins and promotes projections of nearly tenfold growth within a year and recovery of the investment in 3.5 to 4.5 months. It also urges donations and partner recruitment, with package volume tied to a percentage-based matching bonus. The speaker’s disclaimer and denial of tricking viewers do not erase these promotional claims and incentives.
